baseline_models.focus_anchor: The oath by the Lord of sky and earth, followed by حَقّ, مِثْل, and تَنطِقُون.
baseline_models.mechanism: The oath spans sovereign source, upper cover, and lower ground, then contracts that total frame into the addressee's immediate act of intelligible speech. Likeness makes speaking an unavoidable local analogue for fixed reality.

activation_trace.role: Sovereignty and ownership supply the comprehensive guarantor of the oath.
What rises and overshadows supplies the oath's upper extent.
The lower realm opposite the sky closes the oath around the whole inhabited frame.
Fixed correspondence to reality supplies the assertion's stable center.
General likeness connects cosmic truth to an ordinary human act.
Intelligible vocalization supplies the immediate, undeniable analogue.

changed_reading.before: A solemn assertion that an unstated antecedent is true.
changed_reading.after: A totalizing oath whose vast claim is made locally undeniable by the addressee's present experience of speaking.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: The combination of حَقّ with the comparison to the addressees' own نطق.
baseline_models.mechanism: Truth is not only possessed but established and displayed. Articulation functions as a sign that makes an otherwise inward meaning outwardly available, so the comparison performs evidence rather than merely decorating the assertion.

activation_trace.role: Establishing and displaying truth turns حَقّ into an evidentiary operation.
A likeness that can report or characterize lets the comparison disclose how the truth appears.
A sign that speaks by making meaning manifest makes the addressee's articulation demonstrative evidence.
The alternate mapped image of a visible identifying mark lets the sworn sky participate as legible evidence.

changed_reading.before: The verse tells the audience that the claim is true.
changed_reading.after: The verse stages truth becoming evident: the cosmic sign and the audience's own articulation both make hidden meaning show itself.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: رَبّ as the oath's agent, حَقّ as achieved condition, and speech as an emergence into actuality.
baseline_models.mechanism: Developmental branches allow the guarantor to be heard as one who tends something to completion and the truth as a condition reaching full readiness. Speech then supplies a small-scale instance of something inwardly formed becoming actual.

activation_trace.role: Tending, repairing, and completing supplies an active rather than merely titular lordship.
The split mapping's nourishment and growth image makes gradual maturation available.
Arrival at an animal's complete condition supplies the endpoint of maturation.
Recovery and improvement after illness supplies a second image of a state becoming fully realized.
Audible speech supplies the completed outward state of an inwardly formed utterance.

changed_reading.before: The Lord statically guarantees a true proposition.
changed_reading.after: The Lord is heard as bringing a latent commitment to completed actuality, analogous to formed speech finally coming forth.

context_deltas.mechanism: The opening oath sequence supplies dispersal, burden-bearing, easy flow, and apportionment of command. Read against that sequence, speaking is a miniature logistics of realization: an inward command is carried, sequenced, divided into units, and released as an audible event.

activation_trace.role: Winnowing dispersal by wind supplies the first outward-release stage.
Bearing a visible load supplies transmission of content.
A heavy burden gives the transmitted content consequential weight.
Continuous flowing supplies movement through a channel.
Opening into ease supplies unobstructed passage.
Separating assigned shares supplies articulation into distinct delivered units.
An obligating command supplies the content whose effects are distributed.
Intelligible utterance anchors the staged process back in the focus comparison.

structural_cues: 51:1-4 forms an ordered four-member oath sequence, with the last three members advanced by ف.
51:5-6 then name the promised as truthful and the recompense as occurring.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ordered participles and the images of dispersal, carrying, flow, division, and command; I supply the causal arrow from command through carriers to realized effect and map that arrow onto articulation. A live alternative is that the four oath objects are parallel witnesses rather than stages.

changed_reading.before: Speaking is only a familiar benchmark for certainty.
changed_reading.after: Speaking models how the sworn command becomes event: content is carried, channelled, apportioned, and audibly realized.

context_deltas.mechanism: The nearby context explicitly makes human القول divergent, conjectural, and reversible. The focus comparison therefore cannot simply certify whatever humans say; it more sharply compares the promised reality with the undeniable occurrence of their speaking as an act.

activation_trace.role: Reality fixed against falsehood marks the side of the contrast that remains stable.
The concrete event of intelligible vocalization remains certain even when its content is not.
The production of القول by articulation directly links the disputed context speech to focus نطق.
Speech that functions as conjecture prevents equating speech-content with truth.
Each party taking a different path supplies the divergence of human assertions.
Turning something away from its direction supplies distortion of discourse.
Falsehood diverted from truth makes the negative contrast explicit.

structural_cues: 51:8-10 places divergent speech, diversion, and the conjecturers immediately before the later comparison to speaking.
The خ ر ص occurrence at 51:10 has no supplied branch inventory and is used only as a structural cue.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence in which human speech can differ and be false; I infer that the focus analogy selects the occurrence of speaking rather than the truth of its propositions. A live alternative is that the earlier polemic and the later comparison operate independently.

changed_reading.before: The promised claim is true just as the addressees' statements are true.
changed_reading.after: The promised reality is as indubitable as the fact that the addressees are speaking, even though what they say may be divided or false.

context_deltas.mechanism: The context moves from an event falling into place to testing by fire, tasting, and arrival in a condition. This changes حَقّ from abstract correctness into a promised reality that will become bodily and inescapably experienced, with speech as the immediate bodily analogue.

activation_trace.role: Fixed reality supplies the claim that the context converts into experience.
Embodied vocalization supplies a present event against which future realization is measured.
Falling and becoming fixed turns prediction into an event that has landed.
Testing metal or a person supplies exposure that proves condition through ordeal.
Experiencing and trying a thing makes the promised no longer merely verbal.
Occurrence and presence in time supply realized state.

structural_cues: 51:5-6 announce promise and occurrence; 51:12-14 answer the demand for when with a scene of testing and tasting.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies occurrence, ordeal, taste, and temporal presence; I join them as a ladder from assertion to embodied realization and take the focus pronoun to include that promised event. A live alternative is that the sensory language belongs only to punishment and does not define حَقّ.

changed_reading.before: حَقّ names the logical truth of a future claim.
changed_reading.after: حَقّ names a future that will land, test, and be tasted as concretely as speech is presently enacted in the body.

context_deltas.mechanism: Apportionment, the Lord's giving, a right located in wealth, deprivation, and allotted provision form a creditor-recipient structure. The focus حَقّ can therefore remain metaphysically true while also sounding as a due claim whose truth demands delivery; the oath's speech is performative as well as descriptive.

activation_trace.role: A fixed obligation supplies the normative force beyond factual correctness.
A particular right owned by its holder supplies a recipient for what is due.
Spoken wording anchors the possibility that the oath does something by being uttered.
Dividing a thing into assigned shares supplies the distributive mechanism.
Sustaining care and completion make the Lord the source who brings the allotment through.
Giving supplies actual transfer from source to recipient.
Accumulated property supplies the store in which a claim is located.
The explicit owned right in wealth grounds the social reading of the focus root.
Deprivation identifies the unmet recipient-side condition that the due share answers.
An apportioned gift links heavenly provision to distributed entitlement.

structural_cues: 51:15-22 moves through reception from the Lord, a right in wealth, signs, and provision located in the sky.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies apportionment, giving, owned right, deprivation, and provision; I connect them as one delivery relation and let that relation color the focus oath as obligation-bearing speech. A live alternative is that 51:19's حق is a local ethical use with no semantic pressure on 51:23.

changed_reading.before: The oath only certifies that a proposition corresponds to reality.
changed_reading.after: The oath also voices a due claim: promised provision and judgment are guaranteed deliveries, and truth entails the right ordering of shares and recipients.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sequence contracts from signs in earth to the addressees' selves, returns to sky, and ends at their speech. The breath branch of نفس makes articulation an inside-out crossing: hidden life or intention exits the body as an audible sign, joining internal and cosmic evidence.

activation_trace.role: A visible identifying mark lets the sworn upper realm function as readable evidence.
The lower realm opposite the sky supplies the external field of the evidence circuit.
Meaning made manifest as though speaking supplies the circuit's nearest demonstrative sign.
Fertile, established earth supplies an external medium in which signs become materially visible.
A manifest mark names the evidentiary function of what is seen in earth.
Stable knowledge after doubt supplies the epistemic result of reading the marks.
Breath exiting the interior supplies the physical bridge from self to spoken exterior.
Insight of the heart turns looking within into cognition rather than surface inspection.
The upper cover containing provision returns the sequence from inward self to cosmic source.

structural_cues: 51:20-23 orders earth, selves and seeing, sky and promise, then the addressees' speaking.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies that scale sequence plus breath leaving the interior and speech making meaning manifest; I infer a rhetorical contraction in which speech completes the sign circuit. A live alternative is that نفس contributes only the ordinary sense of self, without a breath mechanism.

changed_reading.before: Speaking is an arbitrary everyday example of certainty.
changed_reading.after: Speaking is the nearest sign in a graded circuit: invisible interior becomes audible exterior, echoing how earth and sky make the promised order perceptible.

context_deltas.mechanism: Garden growth, the Lord's giving, fertile earth, nourishment, and a sign that promises a coming state activate the focus-only maturation model. The promised does not merely wait offstage; it is tended toward its due condition until it emerges into actuality, as an utterance matures into speech.

activation_trace.role: Nourishment and growth supply the developmental force attributed to lordship.
A creature reaching full condition supplies a material image for promise reaching actuality.
Produced speech anchors maturation in a focus act with an observable completed state.
Intertwining and surging vegetation supplies active growth within the promised garden.
Giving supplies the transition from nurtured possibility to received result.
Tending and completing grounds the developmental reading in the contextual Lord.
Soft fertile earth supplies the substrate in which latent life becomes established growth.
Nourishing food supplies what sustains development toward completion.
A promising sign from which a future state is expected supplies latent futurity already showing its direction.

structural_cues: 51:15-16 presents the promised garden as received giving from their Lord; 51:20-22 places fertile earth and nourishment immediately before the focus oath.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies growth, tending, giving, fertility, nourishment, and an anticipatory sign; I infer that these form a maturation process and map completed utterance onto its endpoint. A live alternative is a simpler supply-and-reception mechanism with no organic development.

changed_reading.before: The promise is a future proposition whose truth is externally guaranteed.
changed_reading.after: The promise is already under cultivation toward its due mature state, and speaking images the moment a formed potential becomes manifest actuality.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it activates the non-speech belt and waist branches of نطق and material fit branches of حق. It remains anchored in the focus sky-earth frame, مِثْل, and نطق, and 51:7 supplies an explicit woven-sky trigger. Downstream prose should present it only as a material analogy for articulated order, not as the lexical gloss of تَنطِقُون.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: Sky and earth as opposed extents, truth as exact fit, likeness as pattern, and نطق as both articulation and encircling band.

activation_trace.role: Tight weaving in cloth or speech supplies truth as internally coherent construction.
A joint or vessel fitting its proper place supplies exact structural correspondence.
A formed model supplies the pattern according to which parts correspond.
A tightened belt supplies binding around a center as the material analogue of articulation.
The place encircled by a band supplies a bounded middle joining opposed extents.
Well-made tight construction turns the sworn sky into a model of coherent truth.
Firm binding supplies the contextual trigger for the girdling analogy.

changed_reading.before: Truth is correspondence stated through an ordinary speech comparison.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, truth is a fitted and tensioned pattern: articulated speech binds distinct units into one coherent form as the woven sky binds its paths.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it draws on the remote covenant branch within ر ب ب and an oath branch within ق س م rather than their immediate surface senses. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit oath, truth-obligation, and speaking, while 51:5 supplies promise and fulfillment. Downstream prose should call it a performative covenant resonance, not identify رَبّ itself with covenant.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus oath spoken by the Lord, with حَقّ carrying obligation as well as truth.

activation_trace.role: A covenant and pledged protection supply the exploratory binding resonance of the divine title.
A binding obligation makes the truth claim commitment-bearing.
Spoken wording supplies the performative medium in which a pledge becomes public.
An oath distributed among its parties supplies a formal commitment structure.
A verbal promise opening expectation supplies the commitment being guaranteed.
Fulfilling a promise in action supplies the covenant's required completion.

changed_reading.before: The oath provides emphatic evidence for a prediction.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the utterance also enacts a covenant: the guarantor binds spoken promise to fulfillment, so its truth is obligation entering public speech.

strongest_changes: The preceding attack on divergent and false قول makes the focus comparison about the undeniable act of speaking, not the truthfulness of human speech-content.
The opening dispersal-carrying-flow-apportionment sequence turns articulation into a small-scale model of command becoming distributed event.
Occurrence, testing, and tasting shift حَقّ from abstract correctness toward an inescapably experienced future reality.
The explicit right in wealth and heavenly provision let حَقّ retain a coexisting normative sense: truth as a due delivery with source and recipient.
summary.what_was_special: The focus compresses cosmic, bodily, epistemic, material, and social scales without forcing one resolution. Speech can simultaneously be self-evident occurrence, manifestation of an interior, a distributed command, embodied realization, and obligation-bearing performance.
remaining_uncertainties: The antecedent of إِنَّهُ may be the promise, recompense, provision, the preceding signs, or the entire oath sequence.
The comparison may privilege the occurrence of speech, its manifesting function, its bodily production, or its performative force; the context sustains more than one.
The maturation, girdling, weaving, and covenant readings depend on branch-level material analogies and should remain exploratory rather than lexical substitutions.
